scenarios.title: Broken-link and isolated-file classification
steps: Wait for the startup scan and inspect both business tabs
Toggle expected isolated files and navigate every reported source
Modify one link and confirm the incremental projection equals a clean rebuild
expected: The deterministic fixture reports five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files
Expected periodic isolation is separated from the default count
Markdown, embeds, frontmatter, Canvas, and explicit Bases links contribute the documented edges

scenarios.title: Explicit reference accuracy and bounded rule preview
steps: Open Broken links and inspect all five diagnostics; confirm Ghost, Missing view target, and Not a link are absent
Navigate the Missing folded target and Missing canvas target sources from their diagnostics
Open Link Integrity settings, switch to Isolated files, and preview the Bounded regex expected-isolation rule
Close and reopen settings, confirm the rule remains enabled with the same pattern, then rebuild the index and inspect both business tabs
expected: The initial and rebuilt results contain five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files; excluded formula strings, dynamic prefixes, and fenced Canvas content yield no diagnostic
Bases opens without fabricated link coordinates; Canvas exposes the broken-text-node identifier and its actual text location
The ambiguous regex previews zero matches without freezing; its saved pattern survives reopening, and the preview and naming controls remain usable

scenarios.title: Continuous search and persistent folder expansion
steps: Open the results sidebar and type Missing continuously in search; select and replace part of the query, then clear it
Switch to Isolated files, show expected isolated files, and select the folder tree
Collapse Periodic, search for a nonmatching path, inspect the no-matching-results message, then use Clear search
Rebuild the index and verify that the folder remains collapsed
Switch Broken links to source-folder grouping, expand a source file, search for that source and clear search, then rebuild the index
expected: Search retains focus, the complete typed query, and its selection during result updates
Clear search restores input focus and the first page without changing filters; Periodic remains collapsed after filtering and an index rebuild
Both business tabs and result navigation remain usable
The source file remains expanded after matching search, clearing search and rebuilding the index

scenarios.title: Confirmed broken body links and safe diagnostic navigation
steps: Observe the untouched base fixture: five broken diagnostics and four default isolated files
Confirm brokenLinks.bodyHints defaults Off, including absent fields and legacy mentionDisplayMode values; confirm no potential mention commands or isolated reverse action
Explicitly run create-body-hint-fixtures in this disposable Vault; open Body Hints Acceptance/Source.md and confirm ten broken diagnostics and five isolated files
Enable body hints; inspect confirmed missing-file, missing-heading and missing-block wave underlines in editing and reading; inspect valid, code, comment, reference-style and embed negative cases
Inspect reasons by hover/focus and Diagnose broken links in the current note on keyboard/touch; follow native links without intercepted navigation
Run repair-body-hint-fixtures and wait for source/target metadata: five broken and five isolated; run restore-body-hint-fixtures: ten broken and five isolated
Test source edits, target updates/rename, CRLF coordinates, Off, reload and unload cleanup; preserve native href/text and Markdown bytes
expected: Only current syntax-proven indexed explicit references with confirmed missing file, heading or block status are marked; invalid/pending/unsupported metadata is never painted as broken
Body diagnostics share sidebar diagnostic toggles and ignore visibility; valid heading/block links keep their existing file-level graph edges
No potential matcher, query, picker, create/undo command, inline hints or reverse lookup remains; old settings are ignored without enabling body hints
Reading requires unique explicit-source and rendered-anchor destination mapping; repeated/third-party ambiguous anchors are skipped and the read-only diagnostic command remains available
Off clears all owned annotations without automatic body reads; fixture preparation is separate from product acceptance

scenarios.title: Arabic direction, mixed-language paths and persistent language selection
steps: Verify the five broken/four isolated baseline, select Arabic while Obsidian uses English, and inspect both business tabs and all three settings tabs
Search using Arabic text and open Connected/Source.md; follow both mixed-language links to العربية/Target-中文-123.md, checking the heading and block destination

In this disposable Vault only, append [[العربية/Target-中文-123#Missing heading]] to Connected/Source.md; wait for six broken/four isolated, run the current-note diagnostic command, and activate its mixed-path diagnostic; undo the append and verify five/four again
Inspect narrow layouts, long labels, rule preview/save/Undo, keyboard arrows/Home/End/Tab on desktop and touch/soft keyboard on Android; close diagnostics and check focus restoration
Switch Arabic, Chinese, English and Follow Obsidian; close/reopen settings and restart the host after saving Arabic; confirm persisted selection and plugin-only direction
expected: Every plugin surface including current-note diagnostics follows its selected language direction without reversing the English host
Mixed Arabic/English/Chinese/number paths remain readable and navigate to the exact note, heading, block or diagnostic source position
Language changes do not change classifications or Markdown bytes; only the deliberate temporary missing heading raises the diagnostic count by one
Controls and visible focus remain reachable at narrow widths; saved language persists across reopening and restart
